map.小角度近似下 T = 2π√(L/g)，输入摆长 L（m）与重力加速度 g（默认: Under the small-angle approximation T = 2*pi*sqrt(L/g); enter the pendulum length L (m) and the gravitational acceleration g (9.81 m/s^2 by default) to get the simple pendulum period T (s).
map.，L 为摆长（m），g 为重力加速度（m/s²），T 单位秒（s）。: where L is the pendulum length (m), g the gravitational acceleration (m/s^2) and T the period in seconds (s).
map.输入摆长 L（悬点到摆球中心的距离，单位 m）。: Enter the pendulum length L (the distance from the pivot to the center of the bob, in meters).
map.重力加速度 g 默认 9.81，月球等场景可改。: Gravitational acceleration g defaults to 9.81 and can be changed for scenarios like the Moon.
map.结果区显示周期 T，保留 3 位小数。: The result area shows the period T to 3 decimal places.
map.物理实验测重力加速度（反解 g = 4π²L/T²）。: A physics experiment measuring gravitational acceleration (back-solve g = 4*pi^2*L/T^2).
map.近似成立；周期与摆球质量无关，只取决于摆长与 g。: Approximately yes; the period is independent of the bob mass and depends only on the length and g.
map.摆球质量影响周期吗？: Does the bob mass affect the period?
map.不影响。理想单摆周期与质量无关。: No. The period of an ideal simple pendulum is independent of mass.
map.大角度为什么不准？: Why is it inaccurate at large angles?
map.大角度时回复力不再是线性近似，周期会略长于公式值。: At large angles the restoring force is no longer a linear approximation, so the period is slightly longer than the formula value.
